label: Motion
summary: Motion graphics: turns a short brief (a title card, kinetic type, a number count-up, a logo sting, a lower third) into an HTML/GSAP composition and renders it to an mp4. Default 3 s at 1920x1080; say vertical or 9:16 for a 1080x1920 clip, or give a length in seconds. Shows storyboard stills, then the clip.
